answer: Quadratic vote pricing with peer-verified liveness. Each identity holds a 100-credit pulse budget per epoch; casting v votes on one proposal costs v^2 credits, so 10 concentrated votes cost 100, the whole budget. Splitting fails too: before tallying, each voter answers an echo probe — a signed peer challenge — and operators that forge sybils in one batch share an origin tag, so the cluster's weight divides by N. Cost: 50 clustered sybils keep one vote's weight yet burn 50 bonds of 0.5 units (25 locked), while one honest voter pays 4 credits for 2 votes.
